name: Majestic Kashmir Tour Package
route: Jammu → Pahalgam → Srinagar → Gulmarg → Sonmarg → Jammu
description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Kashmir with this carefully designed tour package. From the lush valleys of Pahalgam to the serene lakes of Srinagar and the snow-covered landscapes of Gulmarg and Sonmarg, this journey offers a perfect blend of nature, relaxation, and adventure.  2 Enjoy peaceful stays in hotels and a traditional Houseboat, explore scenic valleys, and immerse yourself in the charm of Kashmir, often referred to as “Paradise on Earth.”
highlights: Explore the scenic beauty of Pahalgam and its famous valleys
Enjoy a stay in a traditional Srinagar Houseboat
Visit Gulmarg, a popular destination for snow and skiing
Experience the famous Gulmarg Gondola ride (optional)
Discover the beauty of Sonmarg, known as the “Meadow of Gold”
Enjoy a complimentary Shikara ride in Srinagar
Witness rivers, valleys, and snow-capped mountains

itinerary.title: Arrival at Jammu – Transfer to Pahalgam
itinerary.desc: On arrival at Jammu Airport / Railway station meet our Representative, who will take you to the Hotel in Pahalgam And Overnight Stay at hotel in Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing – Transfer to Srinagar
itinerary.desc: After Breakfast ,Take a Tour of Pahalgam, Pahalgam Has Places Like Betab Valley, Aru Valley, Baisaran, Chandanwadi and more. Leave For Srinagar later and enjoy Your Stay at Srinagar Hotel/Houseboat

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Excursion
itinerary.desc: Early in the morning leave for Gulmarg. A town, a hill station, a popular skiing destination during winters. Gulmarg is famous because of its “Gulmarg Gondola,” one of the highest cable cars in the world (Direct Payment Basis). Return Back to Srinagar

itinerary.title: Day 4
itinerary.desc: Sonmarg Excursion Today you embark on a full day excursion to the picturesque 'meadow of gold’ Sonamarg. The fast flowing Sindh River makes it popular for trout and masher fishing in summer. You can opt for a pony ride to one of the glaciers for some fun in snow and ice (by your own payment). Return to the Hotel in Srinagar in the evening and enjoy comfortable overnight stay. Note: The vehicle will drop and pick you up at Sonmarg car stand. To reach the glaciers, you can hire ponies by your own payment basis. Return to the Hotel in Srinagar in the evening and enjoy comfortable overnight stay

itinerary.title: Day 5
itinerary.desc: Departure Early in the morning After Breakfast Leave for Jammu Airport/Railway Station to continue your journey with all the beautiful memories from the trip

exclusions: Local sightseeing in Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Sonmarg, Doodhpathri
